recommendation: Keep the REST mark recorder running as report-only supplemental evidence, but do not let a REST receipt alone certify an exact five-second HIP-3 risk path until response staleness is causally bounded and encoded in the path gate.
why_now: The first independently paired live overlap is large enough to test mark semantics, and SPCX falsified the predeclared one-basis-point maximum even at a 40.165ms receipt separation.

spcx_worst_pair.interpretation: The REST response matched a websocket context observed approximately one second earlier rather than the nearest websocket state. This is evidence of response staleness or update-order divergence, not proof of a pricing formula mismatch.

applicable_market_regime: Transport and risk-path provenance issue; not conditional on trading direction or price regime.

alternatives_considered.option: Relax the tolerance above 1.405bps after observing the failure
alternatives_considered.reason: This would be post-result threshold tuning and would hide the measured one-second context lag.

alternatives_considered.option: Treat REST receipt time as exact mark observation time
alternatives_considered.reason: The response carries no exchange observation timestamp and the SPCX row matched an older websocket context.
It preserves exact update evidence but does not distinguish an unchanged mark from a transport outage during long update gaps.

alternatives_considered.option: Merge websocket primary evidence with lag-aware REST supplementation
alternatives_considered.reason: This retains update precision while allowing repeated public snapshots to add evidence only when a conservative lag bound remains satisfied.

expected_upside: Prevent technically unresolved or stale HIP-3 mark paths from being mislabeled as exact while continuing to accumulate useful prospective evidence.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: A small observed sample may understate the tail of REST response lag.
Matching repeated prices can under-identify the true age of a context.
A websocket outage removes the comparison source precisely when REST supplementation is most needed.
Using local receipt timestamps cannot recover an exchange timestamp omitted by the endpoint.
validation_completed: One-to-one pairing prevents websocket row reuse.
Exact immutable parquet file manifests were hashed and rechecked before publication.
Both symbol reports were independently recomputed from the frozen manifests.
The 1.405bps SPCX mismatch persists with a 50ms pairing bound.
No signing client, order path, strategy route, or live configuration was touched.
validation_still_required: Accumulate a predeclared larger overlap window and report REST-to-latest-websocket full-context lag quantiles and maxima.
Define and test a conservative effective observation timestamp or unresolved predicate for REST-supplemented bars.
Falsify the merged path gate with delayed, reordered, and absent websocket evidence.
Re-run the exact v51 lifecycle tool only after source-lag handling is frozen.
success_metrics: No selected lifecycle is marked resolved from a REST row whose conservative effective age exceeds 5000ms.
All source substitutions retain exact source and timestamp provenance.
A delayed REST context is either aged conservatively or makes the lifecycle technically unresolved.
Prospective SP500 and SPCX lifecycle results remain unchanged under an independent artifact recomputation.
failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any report labels REST receipt time as an exchange observation timestamp.
Any source mismatch is silently filtered or resolved by threshold relaxation.
Any research-only source adapter becomes reachable from live execution factories or routing.
Any live strategy or risk behavior changes without explicit approval.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Implement and falsify a report-only lag-aware HIP-3 mark-path resolver, then replay the next attributable SP500/SPCX lifecycle without opening untouched performance evidence prematurely.
